title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > shntool > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Superb soundboard recording of the legendary 9/19/1970 show, highlighted by an other‑worldly Dark Star and a ripping Not Fade Away → Darkness jam.
ai_review.review: The matrixed SBD capture is crystal‑clear with only occasional faint hiccups, delivering one of the most celebrated 1970 performances.  The set rides on a monumental Dark Star that morphs into St. Stephen, launches into a thunderous Not Fade Away and a blazing Darkness jam before a wild Turn‑On‑Your‑Love‑Light finale.  Jerry’s lead work is incendiary, Bob Weir’s dual‑guitar interplay shines, and the rhythm section drives every peak with precision.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance (standout Dark Star, NFA, Lovelight) and the superb soundboard/matrix recording; only minor technical quirks are noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced SBD (80 % board, rest matrix) with superb instrument separation. A few reviewers note a faint scraping noise around the 16‑minute mark and minor hiccups, but overall the tape is considered flawless for the era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic early‑’70 fill‑in with a soaring Dark Star that segues into St. Stephen, then rockets through Not Fade Away → Darkness → China Cat → NFA reprise before closing with an exuberant Lovelight.  The second half is a continuous peak of energy and improvisational depth.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his soaring tone on Dark Star, feedback squeal, and fierce lead work on the China Cat segment.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned briefly for his ‘bomb’ opening on Morning Dew; no detailed critique.
band_member_comments.Bob: Lauded for dual‑guitar interplay, especially during the Feeling Groovy jam and China Cat sections; noted as “awesome” in later reviews.
band_member_comments.Drums: Described as perfectly matched with the guitars, driving the high‑energy peaks of Dark Star, NFA and Darkness jams.
